header.title: CRM Intelligence
header.description: When enabled, call recordings are automatically transcribed (Hindi & English) and analyzed by AI — producing a summary, action items, an outcome status, and two 0–10 ratings (how well the caller advanced their goal, and how the call landed for the lead). Each analyzed call deducts AI credits.

callAnalysis.title: Call Analysis
callAnalysis.description: Choose which call sources are analyzed and the thresholds that gate it.

manual.label: Manual uploads
manual.help: Recordings a counsellor uploads for an off-platform call.

telephony.label: Telephony calls
telephony.help: Calls placed through Exotel / Airtel etc.

ai.label: AI agent calls
ai.help: Calls placed by the AI voice agent (Aavtaar).

minDuration.label: Minimum call seconds
minDuration.hint: Skip calls shorter than this — usually voicemail blips.

callAnalysis.analyzeNotConnected: Also analyze calls that didn’t connect

rubric.title: Scoring Rubric
rubric.description: These are the sales-call skills the AI grades each rep on. The call objective is inferred from the conversation (an optional hint nudges it); each quality below is scored 0–10 within the caller’s rating, and drives the “Skill breakdown” in Coaching. Changes apply to calls analyzed after you save — use “Re-analyze” on a past call to rescore it against a new rubric.

ratedMetrics.label: Rated metrics
ratedMetrics.description: Add any metric your sales team cares about. The <1>meaning</1> you write is sent to the AI so it grades a custom metric exactly the way you define it.

qualityDescriptions.rapport: Building trust early — warm opening, using the lead’s name, matching their tone.
qualityDescriptions.needs_discovery: Asking questions to uncover the lead’s goals, situation and pain before pitching.
qualityDescriptions.objection_handling: Acknowledging and resolving concerns (price, timing, trust) instead of talking past them.
qualityDescriptions.next_step_secured: Locking a concrete next action — demo booked, callback time set, payment link sent.
qualityDescriptions.value_articulation: Explaining the offering’s value in terms relevant to this lead’s needs.
qualityDescriptions.pitch_clarity: Presenting the course/offer clearly and concisely, without rambling.
qualityDescriptions.active_listening: Letting the lead speak, not interrupting, and reflecting back what they said.
qualityDescriptions.urgency_creation: Giving a genuine reason to act now (limited seats, deadline, current offer).
qualityDescriptions.closing: Asking for the commitment and driving toward a clear decision.
qualityDescriptions.talk_listen_balance: A healthy talk-vs-listen ratio — not dominating the call.
qualityDescriptions.follow_up_commitment: Getting the lead to agree to a specific follow-up, not a vague “maybe”.
qualityDescriptions.tone_confidence: Speaking with confidence, energy and professionalism throughout.
